parameters.query:
SELECT
     c.clip_id,
     c.file_path,
     c.title,
     c.transcript,
     c.clip_class,
     c.tags,
     duc.channel_key
   FROM daily_upload_counts duc
   JOIN clips c
     ON c.clip_class = duc.channel_key
    AND c.status = 'queued'
   WHERE duc.count < 1
   ORDER BY duc.channel_key, c.created_at
   LIMIT 1;
